text: Coffee with Marisol. Her knee op is booked for 2 November 2026 at the Royal Free. She's pretty nervous about the general anaesthetic. Her sister Petra is staying with her for the first week.
Damian and Adriana got a puppy! Cockapoo called Biscuit, came home Saturday. Damian's working from home all week to settle her in. Adriana says she's already chewed a skirting board.
Ahmed lives in Leeds now, works at the council in planning. His wife is a midwife at St James's. Two kids, both at primary.
Lwazi had his gallbladder out on Monday. Home now but sore, can't drive for a few weeks. Need to drop round a lasagne before the weekend.

Long catch-up with Yaw tonight. His mum's hip replacement went fine last Thursday and she's already doing laps of the ward with a frame. He's driving up to Birmingham every weekend to help out though, and he's knackered. His brother Femi is supposed to take over in a fortnight. Yaw mentioned he's been getting into bouldering to switch off. Should check in with him next week, he sounded flat.
Jaya's cat Pickle is at the vet again, kidney stuff. They're doing bloods tomorrow. She's really worried, he's fifteen.
Afua's moving to Glasgow in March 2027 for a job at the uni. Her partner Jack is staying in Manchester until his contract ends.
Eduardo said his dad's going in for a heart scan next Tuesday. Remind me to text Eduardo Tuesday evening to see how it went.
Reza Khan, met through Anil. Accountant, lives in Croydon, originally from Shiraz. Massive Arsenal fan.
Anika's dog Bramble turns 3 on Friday and she's actually throwing a party for it. Me, Dong and Noor invited. Noor is bringing dog cake from that bakery.
Dentist moved to Thursday 9am. Pick up prescription on the way back.
Jonah's surgery got cancelled again, third time. Hospital had no beds. He's furious and still in pain with the hernia. New date supposedly sometime in January 2027 but nothing confirmed.
Mia and her husband are in Lisbon for their anniversary this weekend. Back Monday. Ask her about the restaurant Zofia recommended.
Zofia - works nights at the children's hospital, ICU nurse. Lives with her girlfriend Chiara in Walthamstow. Chiara's a primary teacher.

Rang Farah. Her little boy Samir has his tonsils out on 14 November 2026, and she's dreading it more than he is honestly. Her mum's coming down to help. Don't forget to send Samir something fun for after, he loves dinosaurs.
Gemma's back from hospital after the appendix thing. Still very tired, off work till next Wednesday at least. Her boss has been decent about it apparently.
Ellie mentioned her nan is 90 on the 30th. Big family lunch Sunday the 2nd.
Ciara's rescue greyhound, Duke, has a lump they're removing tomorrow morning. She's trying to act calm about it. Text her tomorrow afternoon.
Bumped into Yosef at the station. He's been at Network Rail for 12 years now, signalling engineer. His daughter just started at Bristol, studying medicine.

Dafydd's still on crutches after the ACL reconstruction in August. Physio twice a week. Hoping to be back on the bike by spring 2027. He and Aleksander are doing the Snowdon walk together once he's cleared.
Need to book the cat in for her jabs. Also flea stuff.
Marisol called - op went well! She's on the orthopaedic ward until Thursday probably. Not allowed visitors till tomorrow. Must send flowers to the hospital, ward 7B.

Adriana's dad Eduardo Lopez had a minor stroke last week. He's in rehab now, speech is coming back slowly. Adriana is going over every evening after work and is exhausted. Her brother lives in Spain so it's all on her. Should offer to have their puppy for a weekend to give her a break.
Ahmed's son Yaw (not that Yaw lol) got into the county under 12s squad. Training starts next Saturday.
Petra works for an architecture firm in Clerkenwell. Lives in Hackney. Vegan, doesn't drink.
Femi's partner had their baby girl on Sunday, 3.2kg, both fine. Called her Ada. Femi on paternity leave for a month.
Jack had a bit of a scare, chest pains, A&E overnight on Wednesday. Turned out to be nothing cardiac thankfully, probably reflux. GP follow-up Monday. Check in with him after that.
Noor's hamster died. Her daughter is devastated. Burial in the garden tomorrow apparently, with a song.

Dinner with Anil and Anika. Anil's starting chemo on 4 December 2026, six rounds every three weeks. They're both being very matter-of-fact but Anika teared up when he went to the loo. Her parents are flying in from Delhi next month to help with the kids. Anil said he'd love some decent audiobooks for the sessions, he's into sci-fi. Set up a meal rota with Dong and Noor.
Dong lives on the boat now, moored in Hertford. Works remote for a fintech. Hates the cold, obviously regrets the move a bit.
Jonah update: op finally happened yesterday. Hernia sorted. Says the morphine was the best sleep he's had in years. Off work two weeks.
Chiara's taking Zofia to Rome for her 40th, 22 March 2027. Surprise. Zofia doesn't know. Chiara asked if I could keep the weekend before free for drinks.
Mia said her cat Ziggy has gone missing since Tuesday. Leaflets up round Hornsey. Keep an eye out, ginger with a white chest.
Farah's husband Reza is having laser eye surgery Friday. She's driving him. He'll be off screens all weekend which he's not thrilled about.
Gemma Baker - Ellie's cousin. Lives in Brighton, does events for a hotel group. Has twin boys, about 7.
Ciara texted - Duke's lump was benign! He's home and wearing a cone, very sorry for himself.
Petra's mum is in hospital with pneumonia, been in since the weekend. Petra's flying to Prague on Thursday. Need to message her before she goes.
Took Mum to her eye appointment this morning. Next one in six weeks. I'm doing the drive again.

Catch-up with Yosef and his wife Afua at the pub. Yosef's had the date for his back surgery through, 18 January 2027, and he's trying not to think about it. Afua's sorting out the downstairs room so he doesn't have to do stairs. Their son is home from uni for Christmas so he can help lift stuff. Yosef said he wants a proper reading chair for recovery - big hint for his birthday in Feb.
Liam got a labrador puppy, Otis. 10 weeks. He's sending me approximately 40 videos a day.
Aleksander's dad passed away on Saturday. Funeral is next Friday in Gdańsk. He flies out Wednesday. Don't forget to send a card to his flat before then.
Samir starts at the new physio clinic in Wimbledon on Monday 3 November. First proper job since qualifying. Ask him how the first week went.
Lwazi's feeling much better, back at work part-time. His wife Anika (other Anika) works at the same hospital, radiology.
Damian mentioned Biscuit has her second vaccinations next Thursday then she can finally go out for walks. He's planning a big puppy walk on the Heath that Sunday, I'm going.
Jaya - Pickle's bloods not great. Vet's put him on a special diet and wants to see him again in a fortnight. She's taking it hard.
Noor and her husband Dafydd celebrated 10 years on Saturday. Went to the Lake District. Their kids stayed with his parents in Cardiff.
Eduardo's dad's scan was clear!! Big relief. He's taking him out for a steak on Sunday to celebrate.
Need to get Mum's birthday sorted. She's mentioned the Le Creuset casserole dish twice now.
Jaya's daughter Mia has her grommets op on Friday morning. Jaya's taking the day off. Mia's 4 and thinks she gets ice cream after. I should drop a colouring book round Thursday.
Zofia's brother Aleksander is a dentist in Kraków. Married to an Irish woman, two kids, comes over every summer.
Femi's dog Rolo had to have a tooth out yesterday. He's fine, bit groggy, eating soft food.
Afua said the Glasgow move has been pushed back to April 2027. Jack's job ends end of March so it works better. They're viewing flats in the West End over Easter.
Met Ellie's boyfriend Dong properly for the first time. Software engineer at the BBC, from Dalian originally, lives in Stratford. Really into film photography.
Uncle Anil's knee scan is Wednesday at 10. Mum's going with him. Call him Wednesday night.

Chiara's mum had a fall at home on Sunday, broken wrist. She's had it pinned and is staying with Chiara for a while. Chiara's stressed trying to juggle that and school. Her mum is diabetic too so meals are a thing. Offer to cook for them one evening this week, maybe Thursday.
Gemma's twins both had chickenpox last week and now she's got shingles. Poor woman. Off work until Monday.
Reza mentioned they've got a kitten coming in two weeks, from his sister's cat's litter. Farah's allergic so she's not keen. Name shortlist: Pistachio or Saffron.
Ahmed asked if I can feed their cat Mango while they're in Lahore, 10 to 17 November 2026. Said yes. Picking up keys from his wife on Sunday.
Hairdresser Saturday 11. Gym after if I can be bothered.

Yaw texted - his mum's back home from hospital as of yesterday, district nurse coming in daily for dressings. Femi's taking over the weekend shifts from next Saturday. Yaw says he finally slept 9 hours. Bring him a decent bottle of rum next time we meet, he's earned it.
